content: machinery/config/generate: NewInput(clusterName, endpoint, k8sVersion, ...Option) with WithSecretsBundle, WithVersionContract, WithInstallImage, WithClusterDiscovery; then Input.Config(machine.TypeControlPlane|TypeWorker) yields a provider that marshals to YAML. Secrets come from the secrets subpackage (NewBundle) and are the thing that must be IMPORTED for an existing cluster. Image Factory: POST yaml to https://factory.talos.dev/schematics returns a content-addressed schematic ID; ISO at https://factory.talos.dev/image/{id}/{version}/metal-amd64.iso, installer at factory.talos.dev/installer/{id}:{version}, PXE at pxe.factory.talos.dev/pxe/{id}/{version}/metal-amd64. Disk images/ISO/PXE honor kernel args + extensions + META; installer and initramfs honor extensions ONLY - kernel args and META are silently dropped.
